text: Dana Whitfield, the VP of Marketing at Acme, met with Dana Whitman from Globex on Monday. Ms. Whitfield opened by presenting the Q3 campaign, and the marketing VP stressed the launch date. The Globex buyer asked about the budget. Later, Dan Whitfield, an engineer at Acme and the VP's sibling, joined the call; the engineer walked through the integration. The follow-up memo was signed D. Whitfield, VP Marketing, and was addressed to Ms. Whitman.

Patient Dana Whitfield was admitted on Tuesday. Dan Whitfield, the patient's parent, signed the consent form. Nurse Dana Whitman took the patient's vitals and noted that Dana was anxious. Nurse Whitman later called Mr. Whitfield to confirm the medication list. The chart lists Whitfield, D. as the patient.

This lease is between Dana Whitfield (Tenant) and Dana Whitman (Landlord). Dan Whitman acts as the Landlord's agent. The Tenant, Whitfield, agrees to pay rent monthly. Repairs must be requested in writing to the agent, who will forward them to the Landlord. Signed: Dana Whitfield; D. Whitman for the Landlord.

Minutes of the annual meeting of the Riverside Housing Co-op. Present: Katherine Doyle (Chair), Kevin Doyle (Treasurer), and Katherine Boyle (Secretary). Ms. Doyle called the meeting to order at 7 pm. The Treasurer, Mr. Doyle, presented the accounts; Kevin noted a small surplus. Kate, as everyone calls the Chair, thanked him for his work. The Secretary read the previous minutes, and Ms. Boyle was asked to circulate them by Friday. The Chair closed the meeting at 8:15 pm.

Senator Paul Whitaker announced on Tuesday that he will not seek re-election. Whitaker has served three terms. His cousin, Paula Whitaker, is a state appeals judge; Judge Whitaker declined to comment. The announcement surprised Paul Whittaker, a local businessman who is no relation and who had donated to the campaign. Mr. Whittaker said the senator had been a friend for years. Asked about his plans after leaving the Senate, Paul told reporters he would return to teaching. The businessman said he would support the senator's chosen successor.
